goal: Fix compiler configuration failures when running Guix builds under emulation for another architecture
Ensure emulated cross-system builds correctly use the target architecture rather than the host system
agreement: Strong support with no open objections
Verified by building cleanly with Guix on aarch64 (hebasto)
Question about how the issue was encountered was answered (sedited)

why: P3 because it fixes configure failures in Guix when using --system under emulation
